title: CAREER OFFERS EASY AFTER THREE DEATHS
why: His answer 2.90 b: Career offers Forgiving on a card after a few deaths, the same offer as the demo.
now: Three deaths in a row in Career, then the next raid shows the easy yes or no card. Yes gives 30 percent less damage and a free medkit for that raid.
